Asha: Heads-up — Zephyrus signed NDA, want to run a 2-week POC. Main ask: model variant 'zephyrus-7b-finetune' compatibility with Dedicated nodes + AWS KMS HSM. Anyone own this?
Liam: I'll take the lead on model fit. Quick Q — is the checkpoint a quantized variant (4-bit) or FP16? Sales said their finetune output was q4_k_m.
Priya: They provided a q4_k_m.bin artifact. On first pass, Dedicated supports q4 variants but attention kernel path differs; need to validate KV cache schema. I'll run a compatibility job tonight.
Nora: Ops question — do they expect KV persistence across sessions? That changes storage/ejection policy. @Ashley can we attach persistent NVMe for this customer?
Ashley (cloudops): We can enable persistent KV on Dedicated via an attached disk; comes with ~+12% token-cost delta for warm-start caching. Also need allowlist for private control plane. Need customer sign-off.
Liam: Pricing ask — Zephyrus expects < $0.015/token for the POC. Can we propose Dedicated + hosted fallback for peaks and bill blended? :thinking: 
deploy-bot: deploy: kicked off compatibility smoke test job 7990012345-compat-run
Priya: Quick synthetic results:
```
./compat-check --model zephyrus-7b-finetune --seq 2048 --profile
Latency p50: 62ms (seq<=1024) -> 241ms (seq>1024)
Warnings: RMSNorm dtype mismatch; fallback kernel used for block-attn
```
I'll open INF ticket and PR for strip-kv optimization (PR #1423) to reduce >1k seq latency.
Liam: Can we do a canary: quantized variant (q4_k_m) primary + FP16 fallback when mismatch triggers? Security: they require AWS KMS with HSM-backed keys in us-east-1.
Ashley (cloudops): AWS KMS HSM = EKM/EHSM path; we have integrations but need legal & infra approval for cross-account keys. I'll start KMS checklist with Legal.
Asha: Action items — 1) Priya: full compat logs + ticket; 2) Nora: storage design + cost delta; 3) Ashley: KMS legal checklist + allowlist; 4) Liam: draft POC SOW + blended pricing proposal. Goal: COB tomorrow for SOW draft. :thumbsup: 
Priya: Posted compat ticket INF-8762 and attached logs. Short excerpt above.
Nora: I'll estimate storage ops and post numbers by EOD.
Asha: Thanks team — cc @legal for KMS path, and @customer-success to prep onboarding notes.
